description: `urljoin(base, path)` resolves a reference: an absolute or protocol-relative path replaces the host. A fixed `seg/` head or a literal reference keeps it. Constant-host requests with a tainted `params=` or f-string tail are not SSRF.

expected.notes: attacker path with a literal base can leave the host
relative head, literal reference, constant host with params=, and f-string head all keep the host
the structural rule agrees with the taint lock
URL passed as the url= keyword
constant url= endpoint with a tainted params= value
